_comment: The Professor's wiring — full absolute paths, editable in the Text tab. Set enabled=false to keep him out of the classroom. Delete this file and the Academy auto-discovers under ~/LOCAL_AI instead. Memory-kind defaults for the X550LA (hard-reboot lesson): ctx caps the KV cache, threads 2 leaves cores for the desktop, n_predict 128 ≈ minutes not tens of minutes at 0.3 tok/s, ask_timeout is how long the classroom waits for one answer. min_free_mb: the ROOM CHECK — the professor refuses to think unless this much RAM is free (null = auto: model size + 800MB headroom); refusing beats freezing the whole desktop.
